why: Three named sources, three obligations. ODbL 1.0 is the licence the Protomaps basemap carries as a Produced Work; osm.org/copyright is where OpenStreetMap states that its data is ODbL and that credit is required; and the OSMF Attribution Guidelines, which that page defers to, is where the credit's actual wording is mandated. The copyright page names the requirement but not the notice — its only example of the notice is an image — so a credit line declared from it alone would be the requirement sentence standing in for the credit.
